title: Output of the Google Ads Domain Checker
description: Results are rows in the default dataset: one row per checked domain in check mode, one row per creative in ads mode, both kinds (row_type tells them apart) in both mode. Run metrics (requests, blocked requests, bytes, charge counters) are in the OUTPUT record of the default key-value store.

results.title: Results
results.description: Domain rows and/or ad rows, see the dataset schema views for the fields.

metrics.title: Run metrics
metrics.description: Requests, blocked requests, bytes transferred, targets by outcome and charge counters for this run.
